text:
Alex: One-liner bazaar! Drop your best single-sentence one-liner. Quick, no context.
Priya: My inbox is a mystery novel written in passive voice.
Noelle: I like my coffee like I like my commits: small and frequent.
Sam: I don't have bugs, I have undocumented features with personality.
Diego: My code compiled on the first try. Today is a glitch in the matrix.
Alex: ok new rule: most reacted one-liner gets to pick Friday's snack.
Priya: also tiny poll: cinnamon rolls or banana bread? react :cinnamon_roll: or :banana:
Noelle: :cinnamon_roll:
Sam: :banana:
Diego: :cinnamon_roll:
kudos-bot: Priya gave a shoutout to Noelle for rescuing the printer jam. +1 karma
Noelle: printer heroics are my cardio.
Alex: last mini-game: fastest sudoku solver challenge at lunch. loser buys napkins.
Priya: I'm in but I cheat with logic and googling.
Sam: I fold under sudoku pressure. I'll cheer.
Diego: napkins are my destiny.
Alex: poll and snack result in 10. thanks for the one-liners, team :)
